components.template:
Best Practices

✅ Use Descriptive Key Names

page_title, button_submit, error_validation

Group related keys with prefixes for organization

✅ Use the Pipe in Templates

{{ 'greeting' | ngccI18n }}

The pipe is optimized for template updates and automatic language switching

✅ Use Service in Component Logic

const msg = this.i18n.t('greeting');

Use the service when you need programmatic access in TypeScript

✅ Handle Missing Translations

if (this.i18n.has('key')) { }

Check if a translation exists before using it

✅ Type-Safe Parameters

{ name: 'Alice', count: 5, isActive: true }

Parameters can be strings, numbers, or booleans

✅ Preload Languages for Better Performance

Load multiple languages upfront to avoid delays when switching

Useful for multi-language apps where users frequently switch languages

button alignment; **Your overrides** change individual colors. The code tabs show exactly what to paste
into your project for the current settings.

### 1. Install

\`\`\`bash
npm install @assistanz/carbideui @carbon/styles @carbon/charts
\`\`\`

\`\`\`scss

import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';

### 🎨 NgccColorThemeSwitcher

The **NgccColorThemeSwitcher** lets you interactively customize your Carbon color palette:
- Select *primary* and *secondary* base colors
- Toggle between base Carbon themes (\`g10\`, \`g90\`, \`g100\`)
- Preview color shades in real-time

#### 🔧 How It Works
- The component uses the **ColorThemeService** with Angular **signals** for reactive theme updates.
- Color changes instantly apply via CSS variable overrides on \`document.documentElement\`.
- Persist your chosen palette by saving the theme configuration in your application settings.

#### 🎨 Sections
The picker is organized into sections, each listing the colors you can change **and the CSS tokens each one drives** (click a token to copy it). Use the search box to find a color or token, e.g. \`info\` or \`--cds-support-error\`.

| Section | Colors |
| --- | --- |
| Brand | brand color, derives buttons, interactive states, charts |
| Surfaces | background, layer 01, layer 02 |
| Text & icons | text, secondary text |
| Borders | subtle border, strong border |
| Status colors | error, warning, success, **info** |
| Links & focus | link, focus ring |
| Accessibility | WCAG target, auto-adjust, live report |
| Result & export | effective palette, applied tokens, copy CSS / settings |

Quick starts: **Carbon**, **Ocean**, **Royal** and **Ember** color themes.

Changes apply live to the **active base theme** (White, G10, G90, G100) and are kept per theme. Status, link
and focus colors are contrast-adjusted for the WCAG target, so the applied value can differ slightly from the
one you pick. Values are stored with the brand color, included in *Copy CSS* / settings export, and cleared
by *Reset to Defaults*.

\`\`\`ts
colorTheme.setThemeColor('g10', 'background', '#eef2f7');
colorTheme.setThemeColor('g10', 'support-info', '#0072c3'); // status, link and focus work the same way

colorTheme.resetThemeColors('g10', 'background');           // one color
\`\`\`

#### 🧱 Usage

\`\`\`

#### 💡 Tip

Carbon Design System Side Navigation shell built with Angular v20+ signal APIs.

## Composition

| Selector | Purpose |
|---|---|
| \`<ngcc-side-nav>\` | Root \`<nav>\` — fixed left panel with expand/collapse |
| \`<ngcc-side-nav-item>\` | Single navigable link (optional icon) |
| \`<ngcc-side-nav-menu>\` | Collapsible submenu with nested items |
| \`<ngcc-side-nav-menu-item>\` | Link nested inside a submenu |
| \`<ngcc-side-nav-divider>\` | Visual separator between groups |

## Basic usage

\`\`\`html
<ngcc-side-nav ariaLabel="App navigation" [(expanded)]="sideNavOpen">
  <ngcc-side-nav-item href="/" iconName="home" [active]="true">Home</ngcc-side-nav-item>

  <ngcc-side-nav-menu title="Settings" iconName="configuration">
    <ngcc-side-nav-menu-item href="/settings/profile">Profile</ngcc-side-nav-menu-item>
    <ngcc-side-nav-menu-item href="/settings/security">Security</ngcc-side-nav-menu-item>
  </ngcc-side-nav-menu>

  <ngcc-side-nav-divider />
  <ngcc-side-nav-item href="/help">Help</ngcc-side-nav-item>
</ngcc-side-nav>
\`\`\`

## Expand / collapse toggle

Add \`[allowExpansion]="true"\` to render the expand/collapse button in the footer.
Bind \`[(expanded)]="sideNavOpen"\` for two-way control.

## Rail mode

Use \`[rail]="true"\` for the compact icon-only variant. All items should have \`iconName\`.

## Active state

Set \`[active]="true"\` on \`<ngcc-side-nav-item>\` or \`<ngcc-side-nav-menu-item>\`.

The story's controls drive a real app: the **Theme** controls pick a preset, base theme, corner style and
button alignment; **Your overrides** change individual colors. The code tabs show exactly what to paste
into your project for the current settings.

### 1. Install

\`\`\`bash
npm install @assistanz/carbideui @carbon/styles @carbon/charts
\`\`\`

### 2. Styles: \`src/styles.scss\`

\`\`\`scss
@use '@carbon/styles/scss/config' with (
  $use-flexbox-grid: true,
  $font-path: '@ibm/plex'
);

\`\`\`

\`/styles/carbon\`; \`@assistanz/carbideui/styles\` alone does not resolve in Sass.

### 3. Providers: \`src/app/app.config.ts\`

\`\`\`ts
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideNgccColorTheme, provideNgccTheme } from '@assistanz/carbideui';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideNgccTheme({
      defaultTheme: 'g10',           // 'white' | 'g10' | 'g90' | 'g100'
      defaultCornerStyle: 'rounded', // 'square' | 'rounded' | 'curved'
      defaultButtonAlign: 'left',    // 'left' | 'centered'
    }),
    provideNgccColorTheme({ defaultPreset: 'ocean' }), // 'ocean' | 'royal' | 'ember' | your own
  ],
};
\`\`\`

\`main.ts\`: \`bootstrapApplication(AppComponent, appConfig)\`. The theme is applied at start-up; you do not need a
switcher on the page. A user's saved choice always wins over these defaults, and *Reset to Defaults* returns
to them.

### 4. Optional: let users change it

\`\`\`html
<ngcc-theme-switcher />        <!-- base theme, corner style, button alignment -->
<ngcc-color-theme-switcher />  <!-- brand color, base-theme colors, WCAG report -->
\`\`\`

\`\`\`ts
imports: [NgccThemeSwitcher, NgccColorThemeSwitcher]
\`\`\`

### 5. Your own theme

Type colors in **Your overrides** (they apply to the selected base theme), switch the base theme and repeat,
then copy the \`my-theme.ts\` tab. Pass the result as \`defaultPreset: MY_THEME\`. Check it with
\`auditNgccColorThemePreset(MY_THEME, 'AA' | 'AAA')\`: the panel in the story shows the same result.

| Section | Color | Custom properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
${tokenTable}

family (hover, text-on-color, …) and contrast-adjusts it for the active base theme, so set them with
\`setThemeColor()\` or a preset's \`themeColors\`, not by overriding the CSS variables yourself. The brand color
(\`brandColor\` / \`updateBrandColor()\`) drives ${NGCC_BRAND_TOKEN_NAMES.map((n) => `\`${n}\``).join(', ')}.

Attributes on \`<html>\`: \`data-carbon-theme\`, \`data-corner-style\`, \`data-button-align\`.
Corner tokens: \`--ngcc-radius-button\`, \`--ngcc-radius-input\`, \`--ngcc-radius-container\`.

  component: NgccColorThemeSwitcher,
  tags: ['autodocs'],
  decorators: [

      providers: [NgccColorThemeService],

  ],
  parameters: {
    layout: 'centered',
    docs: {
      description: {
        component: `
### 🎨 NgccColorThemeSwitcher

The **NgccColorThemeSwitcher** lets you interactively customize your Carbon color palette:
- Select *primary* and *secondary* base colors
- Toggle between base Carbon themes (\`g10\`, \`g90\`, \`g100\`)
- Preview color shades in real-time

#### 🔧 How It Works
- The component uses the **ColorThemeService** with Angular **signals** for reactive theme updates.
- Color changes instantly apply via CSS variable overrides on \`document.documentElement\`.
- Persist your chosen palette by saving the theme configuration in your application settings.

#### 🎨 Sections
The picker is organized into sections, each listing the colors you can change **and the CSS tokens each one drives** (click a token to copy it). Use the search box to find a color or token, e.g. \`info\` or \`--cds-support-error\`.

| Section | Colors |
| --- | --- |
| Brand | brand color, derives buttons, interactive states, charts |
| Surfaces | background, layer 01, layer 02 |
| Text & icons | text, secondary text |
| Borders | subtle border, strong border |
| Status colors | error, warning, success, **info** |
| Links & focus | link, focus ring |
| Accessibility | WCAG target, auto-adjust, live report |
| Result & export | effective palette, applied tokens, copy CSS / settings |

Quick starts: **Carbon**, **Ocean**, **Royal** and **Ember** color themes.

Changes apply live to the **active base theme** (White, G10, G90, G100) and are kept per theme. Status, link
and focus colors are contrast-adjusted for the WCAG target, so the applied value can differ slightly from the
one you pick. Values are stored with the brand color, included in *Copy CSS* / settings export, and cleared
by *Reset to Defaults*.

\`\`\`ts
colorTheme.setThemeColor('g10', 'background', '#eef2f7');
colorTheme.setThemeColor('g10', 'support-info', '#0072c3'); // status, link and focus work the same way
colorTheme.resetThemeColors('g10');                         // whole theme
colorTheme.resetThemeColors('g10', 'background');           // one color
\`\`\`

#### 🧱 Usage
\`\`\`html
<ngcc-color-theme-switcher></ngcc-color-theme-switcher>
\`\`\`

#### 💡 Tip
You can combine this with **CarbonThemeService** for full theme & color control across your enterprise app.
        `,
      },
    },
  },
}

Three independent toolbar categories. addon-themes registers every decorator under one
global key, so stacking withThemeByDataAttribute() would leave only the last menu; custom
globalTypes give each category its own menu.

Attributes are set directly for instant feedback, and the same values are written to the
key NgccThemeService persists to, so a story that injects the service starts from the
toolbar's choice instead of resetting it.
